scholarships.title: GKS (Global Korea Scholarship) Program - Undergraduate Degree Programs
scholarships.official_source: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea

existing.description: The Korean government-invited scholarship degree programme that funds a year of Korean language training followed by an associate degree (2-3 years) or bachelor's degree (4-6 years) at a designated GKS university in Korea. The published benefits list is airfare, Korean language training fees, tuition and monthly allowances. Selection runs through two routes: an Embassy Track that applies through the Korean embassy/consulate, and a University Track in which the student applies directly to a GKS-designated university (UIC specialisation and Associate Degree).
eligibility: Nationality: Applicants and both of their parents must hold non-Korean citizenship
Age: Applicants must be under 25 years of age as of the applicable year
Education: Associate Degree Program - High school graduate or expected to graduate; Bachelor's Degree Program - High school or associate degree graduate or expected to graduate

Academic Performance: Applicants must meet the academic performance requirements, such as a cumulative score of 80% or higher, ranking within the top 20% of their class, or meeting the required CGPA threshold
Embassy Track General and Overseas Korean applicants may apply to up to three universities, including at least one Type B university
Embassy Track R-GKS applicants may apply to up to two Type B universities
The UIC Program under University Track provides customized curriculum and field experience through industry-university cooperation focused on the fields of natural science and engineering
Specialization (UIC) is available only for associate and bachelor's degree programs
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants and both of their parents must hold non-Korean citizenship, be under 25 as of the applicable year, hold the published minimum educational qualification for the track, and meet the published academic-performance requirement.
requirements: Korean language training (1 year) + degree programs
Detailed information on universities and academic departments can be found in the 'University Information File' available for download from the GKS announcements
For detailed information, please refer to the application guidelines and announcements posted in the GKS notices
application_method: Read the eligibility criteria and choose the track (Embassy Track General, Embassy Track Overseas Korean, Embassy Track R-GKS, University Track UIC, or University Track Associate Degree)
For Embassy Track: apply online through Study in Korea (www.studyinkorea.go.kr)
For University Track: apply directly to a GKS-designated university
Submit the application so it is received within the published track window (Embassy Track September; University Track September - November)
Await screening and selection (October - December) by Embassy -> NIIED -> University, or University -> NIIED
Receive final results from NIIED in December
existing.selection_notes: Two-stage selection. Embassy Track: the applicant's embassy/consulate screens and selects first, then NIIED, then the university. University Track: the university screens and selects first, then NIIED. Final results are announced by NIIED in December. Selection quota for the undergraduate programme is 286 places in total: Embassy Track 156 (General 88, Overseas Koreans 7, R-GKS 61) and University Track 130 (UIC 100, Associate Degree 30).
existing.best_fit: Non-Korean nationals under 25 who hold a high-school diploma (bachelor's track) or are entering an associate degree programme, and who meet the published academic-performance threshold; also international students from R-GKS partner countries applying through the Embassy Track.
existing.notes: Separate track from the GKS Graduate Degree Programs: different quota, different university lists (undergraduate lists 28 Type A and 42 Type B/R-GKS universities), a compulsory one-year Korean language training year, and a different application route. The University's University Information File carries the department-level detail. The 'Apply for the GKS(Global Korea Scholarship)' control on the page returned the on-page message 'It is not the application period.' on 2026-10-01, which relates to the Study in Korea online route used by the Embassy Track; the University Track route is a direct application to the university.
existing.duration: Korean language training (1 year) + associate degree programs (2-3 years), bachelor's degree programs (4-6 years)
existing.application_period: Embassy Track: applications accepted in September. University Track: applications accepted September to November. On 2026-10-01 the University Track falls inside the published September-November window; the Embassy Track submission month published is September.
existing.deadline_display: Announcement by NIIED in September. Application submission: Embassy Track in September; University Track September - November. Screening and selection October - December. Final results announced by NIIED in December. The page publishes month-level timing only; no day-level deadline is published on this page.
